original: 人々が一斉に走り出した。

en.text: People started to run all at once.

en.text: As soon as they realized the mayor was on his way down, his critics started coming out of the woodwork.

en.text: All the church bells started ringing together.

original: 学生は皆一斉に立ち上がった。
